description: Check whether domain names are registered, asking each TLD's registry directly (RDAP). Returns registered, available, likely_available (no registry lookup service, but no DNS records either) or unknown, plus the registrar and dates for taken names and the cheapest prices for open ones. Up to 20 names per call. A lookup is not a reservation: names can be taken at any moment, and premium or reserved names may still be priced higher or blocked at checkout.
name: check_availability
title: Check domain availability
